Patient: Charlie Nwosu (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-5015
Date of service: 2026-10-23
Place of service: 22
Endoscopist: Dr. Ana Lucia Prieto, MD (fictional)

Procedure
ERCP, attempted.

Indications
Suspected choledocholithiasis with a dilated common bile duct on ultrasound.

Technique
The duodenoscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum. The major papilla was located at the rim of a large periampullary diverticulum. Multiple attempts at biliary cannulation were unsuccessful. No sphincterotomy was performed and no stent was placed.

Impression
Failed biliary cannulation due to a periampullary diverticulum.

Recommendations
EUS-guided rendezvous or percutaneous access will be considered at a tertiary center.
